[← Telecom](../index.qmd)

What happens between switching a phone on and the first data packet: how it finds a 5G cell, learns its identity and beam, knocks on the door with random access, and gets its timing right. Six sections, each from the basic idea to the 3GPP detail.

## Sections

::: {.lesson-table .column-page}
| | Section | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [The SS/PBCH Block](lectures/01-ss-pbch-block.qmd) | What the SSB is and why phones look for it first; PSS, SSS and PBCH inside it; size and period; SSB power and the pathloss estimate |
| 2 | [PSS, SSS & PCI](lectures/02-pss-sss-pci.qmd) | How the phone detects the cell ID; 3 × 336 = 1008 PCIs; PSS and SSS sequences; PCI planning rules (collision, confusion, mod 3, mod 4) |
| 3 | [SSB Beam Sweeping](lectures/03-ssb-beam-sweeping.qmd) | Why mmWave cells sweep beams; SSB index = beam; burst patterns (cases A–E) and the 5 ms window; SMTC measurement windows; beam count trade-off |
| 4 | [PRACH & Random Access](lectures/04-prach-random-access.qmd) | Why a phone must do random access; the 4-step and 2-step procedures; preambles and RACH occasions; mapping to SSB beams; PRACH power ramping |
| 5 | [Cell Radius & Timing Advance](lectures/05-cell-radius-timing-advance.qmd) | Why distance delays the signal; timing advance; PRACH formats and maximum cell radius; cyclic shifts (N_CS) and root planning |
| 6 | [Power-On to First Byte](lectures/06-power-on-to-first-byte.qmd) | All steps from switching on to the first data packet; MIB, CORESET#0 and SIB1; cell selection; RRC setup and registration; finding the failing step |
:::

## How each section works

Every section climbs in three steps, so you can stop where you need to:

1. **Beginner · the idea**: what it is and why it matters, in plain words.
2. **Intermediate · how it works**: the mechanism, with the key numbers.
3. **Advanced · expert depth**: equations, 3GPP clauses and field practice.

Then a short **Practice** slide with exercises (answers in the speaker
notes, press **S**) and the references.

**Previous:** [Chapter 1 · The Air Interface](../ch1-the-air-interface/index.qmd) · **Next:** [Chapter 3 · Measuring the Radio](../ch3-measuring-the-radio/index.qmd)
